title: Icicle 16x
description: A winter themed 16x PVP Texture Pack made for Packmas 2024 Day 11
body:
A winter themed 16x PVP Texture Pack made for Packmas 2024 Day 11
Packmas is collabaration between many Packmaker to release a bunch of winter and Christmas themed Packs 
Icicle was Published on Day 11 of Packmas 2024 and has a ice nad winter theme with a more detailed style
